summary.text: Bianca Mittendorf is the Democratic candidate for the Utah House of Representatives, District 7, in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing incumbent Republican Ryan Wilcox.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she began her career in special education and is now director of human resources and equity for a unionized nonprofit.

paragraphs.text: In a Ballotpedia survey, Mittendorf said she worked directly with students and families in public-school special education before moving into human resources and equity work, where she leads organizational strategy, workforce development and equity initiatives.
She said she lives in Weber County with her spouse, a veteran, and their three daughters.
Mittendorf listed childcare, stable housing and strong public schools among her campaign priorities, saying she wants practical solutions that make daily life more affordable for families.
She also named expanded childcare access, responsible growth, civil rights protections and economic stability for working families as policy interests.
